description: Windows Dynamic Island with music visualization, synchronized notifications, privacy indicators, and fullscreen-aware behavior.
notes: The official setup.iss confirms this is an Inno Setup package and defines lumen.exe and the assets directory directly under {app}. Scoop uses innosetup extraction and does not execute the vendor installation steps.
The vendor installer creates an optional startup task and AppUserModelId registry entries. These setup actions are not executed by Scoop's payload extraction.
The v0.2.1 SHA-256 matches the GitHub Release asset digest. The application's own cache under %LOCALAPPDATA% may remain after Scoop uninstall.
